about: The replay of gate ET5 (council/records/2026-11-22-eda-tools-seat-account.md): run 45073595509, a replay of flow/axil-timer dispatched on main at c99ef1fe (the merge of ip#444), whose replay job ran the tools that read seat Verilog as the seat account nirmaan-seat and whose rejudge job re-judged the replay's records. Each field is copied from the run's uploads (live-eval-replay-45073595509 and live-eval-rejudged-45073595509): the manifest and summary (without their times and usage totals), the trial's case, passed, gate_runs, scores and judge_runs, the RTL stage's gate_runs, and the rejudge result. It shows that in that run the reference answer's RTL stage passed lint.run, simulator.run and synth.run, check 1 passed on its staged testbench, check 2 passed on the clean inputs and failed 4 of 4 mutants, and the rejudge found the trial the same; the replayed and the rejudged trial files are byte for byte the same (the sha256 below). It records no run of the timer's controls or of the committed fixtures: the run's uploads hold none, and those are the repository's own tests, not part of this record.
